title: Lead App-Entwickler / Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d) Social Startup
description:
Wir sind StrayCity, ein dreiköpfiges Startup-Team, das Social Media neu erfindet: Real Connections Powered by Magic, Not Algorithms . Wir entwickeln eine entfernungsbasierte App mit virtuellen Räumen und nostalgischer Pixel-Art-Ästhetik. Für diese Vision suchen wir ein engagiertes Teammitglied, das auf ehrenamtlicher Basis (mit der Aussicht auf eine spätere Provisionsbasis/Beteiligung) unsere technische Umsetzung leitet.
Aufgaben
Komplette Programmierung und Architektur der StrayCity-App von Grund auf (Frontend & Backend).
Integration von Geolocation-Diensten und Echtzeit-Kommunikation für unsere virtuellen Räume.
Übersetzung unserer kreativen, nostalgischen Visionen und Pixel-Art-Assets in performanten Code.
Proaktive und warme Kommunikation im Remote-Alltag (z. B. auf Slack), um das Team regelmäßig mit eigenen kreativen Ideen zu inspirieren.
Qualifikation
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Mobile-App-Entwicklung (Full-Stack) anhand eines Portfolios.
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; dein fester Wohnsitz befindet sich jedoch in Deutschland.
Du teilst unsere Sehnsucht nach echten, "altmodischen" sozialen Werten abseits von reinen Algorithmen.
Du schätzt eine familiäre, urteilsfreie Teamkultur und bringst das Durchhaltevermögen mit, an einem ambitionierten Startup-Projekt bis zur anstehenden Finanzierung mitzuwirken.
Benefits
Ein warmes, kreatives Startup-Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen wertgeschätzt und direkt umgesetzt werden.
100 % Home-Office mit maximaler Flexibilität bei der Zeiteinteilung.
Ein ehrenamtlicher Einstieg mit der klaren Perspektive auf eine Provisionsbasis oder Umsatzbeteiligung, sobald das Projekt wächst.
Wir freuen uns sehr auf dich! Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf, ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio deiner bisherigen Coding-Projekte und ein kurzes Bewerbungsschreiben, das zeigt, warum unsere Vision zu dir passt.
Zusätzlic

title: Solutions Engineering, Ads Solutions (Singapore)
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers to deeply understand their businesses and needs, helping inform the development of products and solutions that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term success on the platform-while maintaining strong standards for user trust and platform integrity.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Ads Solutions Engineer to partner with advertisers and agencies throughout the pre-sales and growth lifecycle, helping them successfully evaluate, launch, and scale on OpenAI’s advertising platform. You will serve as the technical expert in the sales process, translating advertiser objectives into scalable technical solutions across measurement, integrations, data activation, and campaign execution.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, and engineering. You’ll work closely with Client Partners, Customer Success Managers, Product, Engineering, Policy, and Operations teams to remove technical blockers, accelerate revenue growth, and shape the future of OpenAI’s ads platform.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with Client Partners during the sales cycle to provide technical expertise that unlocks new business and accelerates deal closure.

- Lead technical discovery with advertisers and agencies to understand data flows, martech stack, measurement requirements, and activation goals.

- Design and recommend implementation approaches for pixels, APIs, server-to-server integrations, identity solutions, offline conversions, and measurement frameworks.

- Guide advertisers through onboarding and launch readiness, ensuring successful setup of tracking, attribution, audience signals, and reporting.

- Troubleshoot technical issues related to implementation, signal quality, delivery, and measurement performance.

- Build compelling demos, proofs of concept, and technical narratives that demonstrate the value of OpenAI’s ads solutions.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to escalate issues, advocate for customer needs, and influence roadmap priorities.

- Create repeatable technical documentation, playbooks, and best practices that scale advertiser adoption globally.

- Help train internal sales and success teams on technical capabilities, integrations, and evolving product features.

You will thrive in this role if you:

- Have 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, adtech, martech, or a related client-facing technical role.

- Have hands-on experience with digital advertising measurement, pixels, conversion APIs, mobile measurement, identity solutions, or CRM/data integrations.

- Understand advertiser ecosystems including tag managers, CDPs, analytics tools, attribution platforms, and data warehouses.

- Can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

- Have experience writing SQL, using APIs, debugging implementation issues, or working with structured datasets.

- Are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and helping build processes from scratch.

- Demonstrate strong ownership, bias for action, and customer empathy.

- Care deeply about responsible platform growth, user trust, and long-term partner success.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Simulation Capacity Optimization
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Our Simulation team is at the heart of this mission, enabling us to safely and rapidly iterate on the Waymo Driver. We run billions of miles of simulations, creating a massive and complex demand for technical infrastructure resources (CPU, GPU, TPU, Storage).

We are establishing a new team called CORPIO (SimEval Capacity Operations, Resource Planning, Infrastructure Optimization). This team is tasked with building a critical capability for Waymo: data-driven, strategic capacity planning and resource optimization. We are looking for a Quant Software Engineer at the L6 level to bridge the gap between sophisticated mathematical modeling and production-scale infrastructure automation. You will be responsible for building the technical systems that forecast demand, optimize resource allocation, and automate infrastructure management, ensuring our simulation environment is both high-performance and cost-effective.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the CORPIO team, you will:

• Infrastructure Modeling & Automation: Design and build production-grade systems and pipelines to automate capacity planning, demand management, and quota allocation.

• Quantitative Forecasting: Implement and maintain sophisticated models for infrastructure demand forecasting, incorporating architectural shifts, peak loads, and time-shifting opportunities.

• Resource Optimization Algorithms: Develop and deploy algorithms to optimize resource utilization across a heterogeneous fleet (CPU, GPU, TPU) and diverse supply models (on-demand vs. reserved).

• Data Pipeline Engineering: Architect and maintain robust data pipelines that ingest infrastructure telemetry and demand driver signals to feed forecasting and optimization engines.

• Outcome Analysis: Build systems to translate resource plans into tangible outcomes (e.g., queue lengths, user demand fulfillment) and develop attribution models for capacity imbalances.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Simulation, Infrastructure, and Finance teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and automated solutions.

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance on the intersection of quantitative modeling and systems engineering, mentoring junior members and influencing the technical roadmap for CORPIO.

You have: 

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Mathematics, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of industry experience solving data science problems, or a PhD in a quantitative field and 3+ years of industry experience

• Expertise using advanced statistical methods in an applied setting; familiarity with ML systems/models

• Strong background in quantitative methods, such as optimization, statistical modeling, or time-series analysis.

• Demonstrated knowledge of Python/SQL/R data analysis libraries and packages

We prefer:

• PhD or Master's degree in a quantitative field 

• Experience in Capacity Engineering or Infrastructure Optimization at scale.

• Familiarity with ML-driven forecasting and optimization techniques.

• Experience with financial modeling or cost-benefit analysis of technical infrastructure.

• Experience building automation tools for resource management and quota allocation.

• Knowledge of simulation work

• Champion a technology-forward approach to financial crime risk management - leveraging AI tools, self-serve data analytics, and model governance best practices to improve how risk is detected, monitored, and managed at Stripe

title: Principal IAM/PAM Security Architect

The Principal IAM/PAM Security Architect defines and evolves security architecture for identity and privileged access across a large, complex, multi-domain environment spanning Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta, as well as cloud-native identities across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
This role sets security standards for each identity environment, leads the definition of emerging Agentic Identity standards for AI agents and other non-human identities, defines requirements for and drives implementation of the Delinea PAM platform, and owns secrets governance enterprise-wide - including API keys, OAuth/OATH tokens, service account credentials, and certificates. The architect partners closely with identity, cloud, and application teams to keep controls consistent, auditable, and scalable.
Responsibilities

•
Identity Architecture & Standards: Define and maintain security architecture and standards across Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and multi-cloud identity (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), covering authentication, authorization, and lifecycle controls.

• Serve as the architectural authority for identity security decisions, aligning platform and cloud teams to enterprise standards across a large, complex identity environment.

• Lead architecture reviews and risk assessments for new identity integrations, platform migrations, and M&A activity.

•
Agentic Identity Standards: Define enterprise standards for Agentic Identity - governance, lifecycle, authentication, and authorization for AI agents and other non-human identities, including provisioning, scoped entitlements, and deprovisioning.

• Track the evolving agentic AI and non-human identity landscape and advise leadership on emerging risks, standards, and vendor capabilities.

•

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Corporate Security at Ramp owns the security of our internal environment: the device fleet, the identity and access layer, and the AI tools employees use for their work. We are hiring a Systems Engineer to build and operate the controls across these systems.

The role is hands-on, writing code and building agentic loops wherever possible rather than solving problems manually. You will help manage device configuration and patching via configuration-as-code, authentication and authenticator policies in Okta, network and gateway enforcement in Cloudflare, and the controls around our enterprise Claude and OpenAI deployments. These systems overlap heavily in practice, and the work is largely about integrating them and automating what would otherwise be manual administration.

You will report to the Corporate Security lead and work closely with IT, Security Engineering, and AI DevX.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Maintain update policies for both OS and software, and monitor the fleet so that newly introduced applications are brought into the patching cadence

- Build automation for endpoint security agent remediation across EDR, DLP, VPN, and similar tooling - detecting missing, stale, or unhealthy agents and bringing devices back into compliance

- Maintain device configuration baselines as code, including drift detection and hardening standards

- Configure authentication and authenticator policies in Okta: SSO, MFA and authenticator enrollment, device trust, and conditional access

- Remediate identity posture gaps surfaced by ISPM tooling: stale accounts, orphaned service principals, over-scoped OAuth grants, MFA gaps, and excess privileges

- Implement and operate controls for enterprise AI usage, including identity-aware access, logging and retention, DLP where appropriate, and enforcement

- Automate across these platforms using their APIs, build reporting on control coverage, and document how the controls you build are operated

WHAT YOU NEED

- 3-5 years of experience in Client Platform Engineer/Endpoint Engineering, Identity Access & Management, or Corporate Security

- Hands-on macOS management at scale: MDM (Jamf, Fleet, Kandji, or equivalent) and macOS update mechanisms

- Working knowledge of an identity provider (Okta or similar): SSO, authentication and authenticator policies, SCIM provisioning, and conditional access

- Scripting ability in Python, Go, or Bash, and experience automating against platform APIs

- Experience with EDR and endpoint vulnerability management (CrowdStrike or similar)

- Ability to evaluate tradeoffs between technical enforcement, policy, and user friction, and to explain those tradeoffs clearly

NICE TO HAVE

- osquery and Fleet, or other query-based fleet visibility tooling

- Identity posture management (ISPM) tooling, or access review and governance platforms

- Cloudflare Zero Trust, or other proxy, DNS, or network-layer enforcement, including TLS inspection

- Exposure to AI and LLM security concerns: agent authorization, tool calls, model gateways, data lea

title: Email Coordinator
description:
About This Role

This is a guest-facing email coordination role at a fast-growing luxury travel and concierge company. Day-
to-day, you’ll be the primary link between guests and the hotels and suppliers that make their experiences

exceptional - gathering trip details, communicating guest preferences to hotels, and ensuring every
interaction is warm, accurate, and on-brand. Rate checking is part of the role, but communication is the
core of it. This is not a task-and-log-off role. Full presence, proactive thinking, and genuine ownership are

expected throughout every shift.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Guest & Hotel Email Coordination (Primary)

• Work with guests via email to gather trip information - preferences, special requests, ETAs, and any last-minute

needs.

• Communicate these details to hotels and suppliers ahead of each arrival, ensuring nothing is missed regardless
of whether the client has replied.
• Handle VIP1 & VIP2 pre-arrival touchpoints: confirm arrivals, brief hotels, and follow up with both parties as
needed.
• Maintain a warm, personal, on-brand tone in every message - it should never read like a template.

Rate Checking (Supporting)

• When a booking comes in, verify the guest has the best available rate by checking the hotel’s public website
and/or booking engine - this is confirmation and verification, not proactive deal-hunting.
• Where needed, contact the hotel directly for pricing and information.
• Flag rate discrepancies and document findings accurately - this is investigative, detail-driven work.
• Occasional quoting may be required; when it is, the focus is on retrieving accurate pricing through the right
channels, not finding the cheapest option.

High-Volume Email Management

• Log in, scan the full inbox, triage by urgency, and label before actioning - never work top to bottom.
• Prioritise flagged and time-sensitive items first; process supplier confirmations, replies, and new inquiries
systematically.
• Maintain inbox zero by end of shift - nothing unresolved or unacknowledged.

Hotel & Supplier Outreach

• Email hotels and vendors to confirm bookings, flag special requests, and follow up on outstanding items.
• Where email isn’t getting a response, escalate to a call - but keep most communication via email where

possible.

Shift Handovers & Notion

• Update Notion at the end of every shift with open items, actions taken, and anything the next coordinator needs
to pick up.
• Keep SOPs and task notes current so the team always has visibility.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Genuine passion for travel - you don’t need a CV full of travel jobs, but you need to actually care about this
space and want to grow in it.
• Thinks on their feet - when something goes sideways, you look for a solution before you escalate.
• Warm, polished written communication - professional but personal, never robotic or templated.
• Attention to detail - you catch what others miss, before it reaches the guest.

• Email triage instinct - you scan, sort, and prioritise; you don’t need to be told what matters most.
• Proactive communicator - if you’re stuck, behind, or unsure, you say so early.
• Comfortable with ambiguity - workflows evolve, and you adapt without needing hand-holding.
• Full commitment - exclusivity required. This role cannot be combined with other employment.

SHIFT & AVAILABILITY

Schedule Hard start and end times - not a task-completion role
Hours 9-hour shift including 1-hour unpaid break (8 productive hours)
Start Time Daytime or evening shift TBD - to be confirmed at offer stage
Weekend At least one weekend day required (e.g. Sun-Thu or Tue-Sat)
Exclusivity No concurrent employment - full focus required from day one

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

Email Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets)
Inbox Mgmt Hiver - shared inbox assignments and email tracking
Task / SOPs Notion - team handovers, booking details, client info
AI Drafting Claude - used to support email drafts and workflow efficiency

• Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts

The Media Advertising Operations Senior Associate is responsible for developing and executing data-driven digital media strategies that align business objectives, brand growth, and performance goals. • Advanced hands-on experience managing, optimizing, and scaling paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Ads, with a strong understanding of platform best practices and campaign structures.

• Proven expertise in performance marketing strategy, including audience planning, full-funnel campaign design, lead generation, conversion optimization, and budget allocation aligned with business objectives.

• Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting key performance metrics such as CPA, CPL, CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and CPM, transforming data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

• Solid knowledge of measurement and tracking frameworks, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, events implementation, and attribution analysis to ensure data accuracy and campaign effectiveness.

• Experience conducting A/B testing, experimentation, and continuous optimization, identifying growth opportunities through audience behavior, historical performance, and market trends.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients, combining strategic thinking, storytelling with data, advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, and presentation development to communicate insights and drive business results.

title: Sr Specialist, Post Market Vigilance
description:
What Post Market Vigilance contributes to Cardinal Health
Quality develops and implements quality policies, procedures, and processes to ensure products and services comply with regulatory standards and specifications.
Post Market Vigilance assesses clinical customer experiences for the company's products and services and maintains regulatory compliance with regard to product complaints and the reporting of safety adverse events for all products manufactured or distributed by the company.
Post Market Vigilance Sr Specialist
Cardinal Health (CAH) is currently seeking a Post Market Vigilance Senior Specialist to join our Post Market Surveillance team. In this role, you will engage in all activities related to the CAH post market surveillance processes by ensuring regulatory compliance and maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety across CAH’s medical device portfolio.
Responsibilities

• Review, evaluate, and process medical device complaints in full compliance with applicable regulations and internal procedures.

• Manage translations through approved translation tool.

• Coordinate and conduct follow-ups with internal and external stakeholders to obtain additional information and facilitate device returns.

• Complaint coding using established proceduralized malfunction codes.

• Perform regulatory assessments and decision tree analyses.

• Review and approve complaint investigations, ensuring thorough documentation and timely closure.

• Conduct investigations for no-sample complaints and support NC and CAPA reviews as applicable.

• Support other tasks as needed such as complaint data pulls and regulatory reporting

• Knowledge of business platforms and processes SmartSolve, Agile PLM, Adobe EchoSign.

• Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners in Quality, Engineering, and Operations to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement.

• Maintain strong attention to detail and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness in all complaint documentation.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills to drive clear alignment of company and department goals

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience preferred.

• 2-4 years of relevant experience in post market surveillance, complaint handling, or a related medical device quality discipline preferred.

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

What is expected of you and others at this level

• Applies working knowledge in the application of concepts, principles and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks

• Works on projects of moderate scope and complexity

• Identifies possible solutions to a variety of technical problems and takes action to resolve

• Apply judgment within defined parameters

• Work reviewed for sound reasoning and accuracy

title: Chief of Staff
description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.

OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.

The role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the CEO.

You are the CEO's closest execution partner. You sit in the rooms the CEO sits in, and represent him in the ones he cannot be in. You make sure the company executes fast on the decisions made in those rooms, by driving the most important cross-team projects yourself.

The mandate has four parts. Run the operating cadence the leadership team works inside. Own the company's commitments and see them through to done. Make the CEO's decisions and priorities legible to everyone they affect. Protect the CEO's time for the work only the CEO can do.

This is a senior individual role with no direct reports. Your authority comes from the mandate, agreed in writing with the CEO, and from being right. You are not a gatekeeper.

We are outcome-driven, direct, high trust and high autonomy. There is very little hand-holding. We enjoy working with people who bring a healthy degree of intensity and drive.

What this role is not

Not an executive assistant. Not a COO. Not a strategy seat where you write decks about work other people do.

What you will do

- Run the operating cadence
Own the quarterly planning cycle, company goals and the weekly leadership meeting: agenda, a dashboard of under 15 metrics, decisions written down, commitments tracked to done. Every red metric gets a root cause and an owner within the week.

- Drive cross-functional execution
When a decision needs three teams and has no single owner, you are the direct responsible individual until it lands. You hold owners to their dates, unblock, and escalate early. Most of these run in weeks, not quarters.

- Make decisions travel
Every leadership decision gets written down and reaches the people it affects within a day. You draft the all-hands deck, decision memos and internal communication in the CEO's voice. The CEO edits; you draft. You hold the bar in the rooms the CEO is not in. When quality or pace drops, you name it that day.

- Build and manage the operating system
Morning briefs, commitments tracking, meeting-to-action pipelines, and the reporting the CEO takes to the board. Build the foundation and systems, so the company gets more legible with less manual work. You do this yourself, not through a vendor.

- Make the company legible
Decisions, processes and playbooks written once, findable by everyone, and used as the standard.

- Take special projects, up to a day a week
You pick them up with CEO-level urgency and hand them back completed, or with an owner and a clear path to done.

Who you are

- You bring energy
High intensity, high pace, and you are impatient when good decisions sit. You set the tempo in a room without raising your voice. People move faster because you are there.

- You have operated inside a fast-changing, venture-backed company
Typically four to eight years in. You have lived through at least one moment where the plan changed under you and you kept the team executing. Titles vary: chief of staff, business operations, founder's associate, program or product lead, consultant who went operating, ex-founder. We care

You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Marketing Manager (Fixed-term 12 months)

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity, and earnings to neighborhoods around the world. From restaurant food to retail, we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything - and we’re just getting started. We’re now looking for a  Marketing Manager to join our local Marketing team in Vienna, Austria. In this role, you’ll bring Wolt’s story to life in your market by leading local commercial and content/social media marketing efforts. You’ll report to the Head of Marketing and play a key role in driving growth across all our business lines - from restaurants and retail to new verticals. You’ll work at the intersection of creativity and strategy: managing local partnerships, building campaigns that resonate with customers, and driving meaningful community engagement. This is your chance to shape how Wolt shows up locally - building brand love and loyalty, one campaign at a time.

What you’ll be doing

As a Marketing Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind Wolt’s local marketing initiatives - bringing our brand to life across cities, communities, and digital channels. You’ll turn insights into creative campaigns, partnerships, and experiences that strengthen our local presence and drive growth across all business lines. This is a hands-on role where you’ll get to blend strategic thinking with creative execution, while collaborating closely with local teams and regional marketing partners to make an impact that truly resonates.

Day-to-day in this role, you’ll:

• Lead and manage local marketing campaigns from concept to execution - ensuring they’re engaging, effective, and true to Wolt’s brand.

• Build strong relationships with local partners and merchants to co-create marketing initiatives that drive visibility and mutual growth.

• Develop and implement the local social media strategy, crafting authentic, relevant, and community-driven content.

• Collaborate with local influencers to produce creative, high-impact content that connects with our audience.

• Activate both organic and paid hyper-local initiatives such as events, guerrilla marketing, and partnerships with community brands.

• Partner with the regional marketing team to ensure that local campaigns align with broader business goals and brand guidelines.

• Track, analyse, and report on campaign performance - translating insights into actionable improvements.

• Support campaign planning for new city or area launches, helping to build excitement and awareness in new markets.

Our humble expectations

• Experience managing and executing marketing campaigns across multiple channels (social, partnerships, events, influencer).

• Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, ideally across commercial, operations, and content teams.

• Strong analytical mindset - confident in using data to measure campaign effectiveness and inform future strategies.

• Hands-on experience managing social media content and community engagement.

• Comfortable juggling both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment.

• Previous experience in food delivery, on-demand services, or e-commerce is a plus.

• C2-level German and business-fluent English .

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
At Rohlik, Supply Chain is about precision, speed and data.

Every day we decide what customers will find in stock - and what they won’t.

We’re now looking for a Supply Chain Specialist who will own a portfolio of categories and suppliers, ensuring strong product availability while keeping inventory healthy and waste under control.

 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- You’ll have a direct impact on product availability for thousands of customers

- You’ll work with real data, forecasts and business decisions

- You’ll see the results of your work in both numbers and customer experience

- You’ll collaborate across Category, Operations and Finance

- You’ll help automate and improve how supply chain processes work

- We are an AI-first company - you’ll work in an environment where forecasting, ordering and supply chain decisions are increasingly driven by data, automation and intelligent tools

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You’ll take ownership of day-to-day supply chain performance within your scope.

Specifically, you will:

- Own demand forecasting, replenishment and ordering for assigned categories

- Manage supplier operational performance and ensure SLA compliance (OTIF, shrink, ASN accuracy, lead times)

- Partner with Category Managers, Fulfillment Operations and Finance to balance availability, cost and inventory health

- Support automation and system improvements to reduce manual ordering

- Resolve supplier and inventory issues before they impact customers

- Track and act on key metrics such as forecast accuracy, shrink and availability

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 1-3 years of experience in supply chain, replenishment, inventory management or similar role

- Strong analytical mindset and communication skills

- Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with BI tools is a plus

- Experience in FMCG, grocery retail or e-commerce is an advantage

- Knowledge of ERP or WMS systems is a plus

- Fluent Czech/Slovak and advanced English

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

- Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary - no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

- Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

- Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility - three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

- Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

- Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live - from day one.

- Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

- Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

- A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

- If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

title: Tax Senior, Business Entities
description:
Bright!Tax is hiring a Tax Senior specialising in Business Entities, to anchor our US business entity work. You will prepare, review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for American entrepreneurs living outside the United States. You will handle most of that work end to end, and you will also review returns prepared by others so our team can learn from you. Between entity deadlines you will carry individual expat returns and the international forms that sit alongside them, so the year stays balanced. You will also mentor the preparers on our team who want to grow into entity work. This is a fully remote independent contractor role, open on location, working the US filing calendar. It will suit someone who is confident making their own judgment calls and comfortable working the way a small, fully remote firm works.
Key responsibilities

• Review, sign, and deliver Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S for expat-owned businesses, and prepare them end to end where that is the better fit.

• Grow into the international layer that sits on top of entity work, including Forms 5471, 8865, and 8858, GILTI and subpart F, and foreign trust reporting. Experience here is welcome, and we will teach it if you have not done it.

• Talk directly with clients by phone and video: explain positions, walk them through their entity returns, deliver completed work, and flag where their facts call for filings beyond the current scope. No selling or business development.

• Mentor and upskill Tax Team members toward independent entity preparation, in partnership with Learning and Development.

• Carry individual expat returns and international filings in the months between entity deadlines.

• Document entity standards, review checklists, and common fact patterns so the work is repeatable, reviewable, and teachable.

Must-have qualifications

• Years of experience: Roughly four to eight years in US tax with substantial entity work, enough to make a judgment call without escalating it. We care more about whether you have owned client relationships and made judgment calls yourself than about the number. We will hire at either Tax Senior or Tax Manager level, based on depth of experience and the technical authority you are ready to carry. At Tax Senior level this seat carries no direct reports. At Manager level it would likely come with direct reports as the entity bench grows. Neither level carries selling or business development responsibility.

• Credentials / licenses (e.g., CPA, EA): CPA or EA required, active and in good standing. Must hold a current PTIN and be eligible to sign as paid preparer.

• Required skills / tools: Forms 1065, 1120, and 1120-S; partner and shareholder basis; K-1 and K-2 / K-3 reporting; working knowledge of the controlled foreign corporation and foreign partnership regimes. Direct client contact by phone and video. Comfortable working in a cloud practice stack.

• Languages (if any): Professional fluency in English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves

• Background in a small firm or your own practice rather than a large firm environment, so you are calibrated to what a client of our size actually needs. If you run your own practice, this cannot be a side engagement alongside it. We need committed capacity across the filing calendar.

• Experience serving US owners living abroad, or time in a firm with an international or expat client base.

• Experience building technical training or running upskilling for a team.

How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether? 
 
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
